name: TFM2 Patch Balance Improvement
summary: Fixes the r21 stat/growth endpoint hook by patching the real caller-side value ratio sites used by newly generated patch notes.
notes: Supports Steam buildid 23466958 with executable patch set official_build_23466958.
Weak uses 80%..125%, normal uses 75%..133.33%, and strong uses 66.7%..150%; the ranges are unchanged.
Action patch values move by 20%/25%/30% of the effective field range for weak/normal/strong instead of jumping directly to the endpoint.
The r21 selector hook at 0x141CF3268 is restored to official bytes because it did not stop newly generated stat/growth endpoint values.
The real stat/growth caller sites at 0x140C3B0CE and 0x140C3D8C2 now scale endpoint ratios 45% of the way from 1.0 before entering the common value generator.
Selected champion count and per-champion item count remain at the strong-baseline volume for every intensity.
The patch-note keep-first and actual stat/growth apply-vector keep-first duplicate guards are retained on the new EXE layout.
Steam updates can restore TeamfightManager2.exe and bundle.game_data, so rerun APPLY_PATCH.bat after updating the game.
